text: きみの　けはいが　ちかづくのを　かんじて　いたよ！

structure.jp: きみの　けはいが　ちかづくのを

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the whole action into a thing that can be felt or seen. けはいが　ちかづくの = 'your presence drawing near'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: いる after a て-form says the action is ongoing, and いた puts that in the past. かんじて　いた = 'I was sensing it'.
